Needs changes before merge: the required app heavy lane is red and incomplete.

The source review found no new code defect. This is a SAFETY-tier review because the change affects posting.

What looks good:
- The budget uses saturating arithmetic and a finite cap.
- The private emitter counter prevents public counter resets from hiding a refusal.
- The tests cover large Tormach programs, direct buffer writes, caught exceptions, and operation names.
- No G-code or CL golden changed. No UI, importer, fixture, dependency, or process file changed.

Results from the local trial merge:
- PR head: `b971753fa66925dd3ad49908de154b23493455c7`.
- Main at the trial merge: `ed8f0322940bba89e67fcb7b106d72347d088f1c`.
- The merge was clean. All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3037`. No GitHub runner was used.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 80 steps passed; 675 tests passed; no failed or ignored tests.
- `post_output_budget`: 8 passed. `script_sandbox`: 11 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Heavy lanes run:
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` selected the app lane: 199 steps, including the release build.
- The release build passed. The gate completed 126 test invocations before step 128.
- Those invocations had 25 passing tests, four expected known failures, and one unexpected failure.
- The expected failures matched the markers for #2845, #2849 (two tests), and #1950.
- `pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` failed at `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:144`.
- Its measured move counts were `(3158, 3130, 1141)`.
- I restored the three upstream post production files and ran that test again. It failed at the same assertion with the same counts.
- This baseline check gives no evidence that this PR caused the failure.
- I interrupted the gate at the review time limit during `shared_face_bodies_finish`. Four of its six tests had passed.
- Two tests in that suite and steps 129 through 199 have no result. The heavy lane did not pass.

Exact unexpected test result:
```text
test the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean ... FAILED

test result: FAILED. 0 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 2 filtered out; finished in 2.08s
```

Mutations:
- I repeated the author's upstream-file mutation for all eight `post_output_budget` pins.
- With upstream `engine.rs`, `js.rs`, and `js_host.rs`, all eight pins failed.
- This includes both large Tormach programs and the refusal and counter-reset checks.
- After I restored the PR files, all eight pins passed. No source change remains.

Extra suites run:
- No extra fixture or importer suite applies. The diff changes no fixture directory or importer.
- The required app heavy lane and the baseline `pocket3d_hsm` test ran as described above.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/post/src/post/engine.rs:116` and the PR body, Tests: complete the required app heavy validation and record its result in the body. The current body reports only quick and clippy results. Upstream main's AGENTS.md, “Heavy lanes at review,” requires the reached lane before readiness. Resolve the baseline failure through the tracked upstream work, then provide passing results for the complete selected lane. Keep the PR as a draft until this requirement is met.

Notes:
- Upstream main advanced during the review. Its post production files match the trial-merge base. Its current AGENTS.md retains the heavy-lane requirement and adds the light lane. The new light tooling was not in the tested base and was not run.
- `engine.rs` was already over 400 lines and grows by four lines. A later split would help; this is not a blocker.
- The private user project and a physical controller were not exercised.

All 199 heavy steps ran. The release build passed. The test invocations had 40 passes and six expected known failures.
One unexpected failure remains: `pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` at line 144.
Its counts are `(3158, 3130, 1141)`, as in the review's upstream baseline check.
All six `shared_face_bodies_finish` tests passed. All later steps completed.

The quick gate passed all 80 steps and 675 tests. All eight `post_output_budget` pins passed.
Clippy passed for `camcraft-post` with all targets and warnings denied.

No source or test change was requested or made. No new pin or mutation applies to this validation-only finding.
The passing heavy requirement remains unresolved. The PR stays a draft.
Please re-review the complete validation record and the remaining baseline failure.

Addressed: finding 1 (app heavy lane). No code change on this branch. The head is unchanged: `b971753fa66925dd3ad49908de154b23493455c7`.

- The complete app heavy run is recorded in the PR body. All 199 steps ran.
- One unexpected failure remains: `pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`, counts `(3158, 3130, 1141)`.
- The same test fails with the same counts on upstream `main` without this PR. The review's baseline check showed this too.
- Upstream issue #3050 (P2) tracks this failure on `main`. Its cause is the STEP reader and mesh changes of PR #2904, PR #2934 and PR #2994. Issue #2371 tracks the macOS aarch64 pin.
- This PR does not change those files. A fix for that test on this branch is outside the scope of #3002.
- The PR merges cleanly with `main` at `d113deaae`. No new pin or mutation check applies.

The PR stays a draft. It waits for #3050. When #3050 merges, I will merge `main` and run the app heavy lane again. Please re-review, or confirm that #3050 is the correct gate for this PR.

Please fix ASAP.

This PR has the label `needs-rework`. The open items are in the latest review comment on this PR. Push a fix, or say that you keep this PR. The maintainer asked for this reminder.

I repeated the author's upstream-file mutation for all eight `post_output_budget` tests.

- RED: all eight tests failed with the upstream implementation.
- This includes `tormach_posts_over_100k_moves_in_a_whole_program` and `tormach_posts_over_100k_moves_per_operation`.
- The refusal, scaled-limit, caught-exception, operation-name, and public-counter-reset tests also failed.
- GREEN: all eight tests passed after restoration. The worktree had no source changes.

Extra suites run:

- No extra fixture or importer suite applies to this PR's diff.
- The complete app heavy lane and the light lane ran as listed above.

Requested before merge:

None. The earlier validation finding is met, including the record in the PR body.

- Upstream main advanced during validation to `1d81b609c8ae0a5ad059b1d5cf141a22cb170457`.
- Its current `AGENTS.md` has the same rules. I checked those rules again.
- A final trial merge with that main was clean. I did not build or test this newer trial merge.
- The results above apply to the stated tested main and the unchanged PR head.
- `engine.rs` was already over 400 lines and grows by four lines. A later split would help; this is not a blocker.
- The private user project, a physical controller, GUI posting, and MCP posting were not exercised.
